stem: A Massachusetts drug store pharmacy license was issued in March 2026. The owner is preparing the facility's renewal calendar and is comparing it with the pharmacist staff's personal registration cycle. When does this drug store pharmacy license expire under the facility-license rule?

choices.text: December 31, 2026, because every pharmacy license expires at the end of the year of issuance.
March 2027, exactly one year after issuance.
December 31, 2027, the next odd-numbered-year December 31 following issuance.
December 31, 2028, because pharmacy facilities use the same even-year cycle as pharmacists' personal registrations.
It has no fixed expiration date as long as a Manager of Record remains employed.

explanation.core_reasoning: Under M.G.L. c.112, §39 and 247 CMR 6.05, a Drug Store Pharmacy license expires on December 31 of each odd-numbered year following issuance. A license issued in 2026 therefore reaches its next applicable facility expiration on December 31, 2027.

choice_analysis.A: The facility license does not expire automatically at the end of the 2026 issuance year.
choice_analysis.B: The rule is not a one-year anniversary cycle.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: December 31, 2027 is the next odd-numbered-year expiration following issuance.
choice_analysis.D: Even-year personal registration timing is a different licensing cycle.
choice_analysis.E: Manager of Record employment does not make the facility license perpetual.

explanation.mpje_trap: Do not import the personal pharmacist registration cycle into facility licensure.

reasoning_steps: Identify that the question concerns the facility license rather than a pharmacist's personal registration
Apply the odd-numbered-year December 31 rule following issuance
